answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 16020 Country: India Title: Asak, Main type-1, insulin-based diabetic patient hun. Mian subah shaam insulin leta hun. doctor ne mujhse kaha hai har 3-4 hrs ke bad kuch na kuch khate rahna becoz sugar kam hone ka khatra hota jo ki jaanlewa hai. Even aik din maine try bhi kiya ki main pure din kuch na khaun nad main dopahar tak kuch bhi nahin liya but meri tabiyat kharab ho gai and meri sugar 100 tak pahunch gai. mera sawal yeh is condition main mujhe roza rakhan chaiye ya nhain becoz iftar ka waqt shaam 7.00 pm ka hai or gara nahin rak sakta to us condition main mujhe kya karna chaiye. Pls resomnse me as ossn as possible? Question: Asak, Main type-1, insulin-based diabetic patient hun. Mian subah shaam insulin leta hun. doctor ne mujhse kaha hai har 3-4 hrs ke bad kuch na kuch khate rahna becoz sugar kam hone ka khatra hota jo ki jaanlewa hai. Even aik din maine try bhi kiya ki main pure din kuch na khaun nad main dopahar tak kuch bhi nahin liya but meri tabiyat kharab ho gai and meri sugar 100 tak pahunch gai. mera sawal yeh is condition main mujhe roza rakhan chaiye ya nhain becoz iftar ka waqt shaam 7.00 pm ka hai or gara nahin rak sakta to us condition main mujhe kya karna chaiye. Pls resomnse me as ossn as possible? Answer ID: 16020 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1713/D=238/K=1430) In the case mentioned above, you are permissible not to keep fast. Later, when feel you can keep fast and the days are shorter, make qadha of these missed fasts. But, if you are not able to fast in future too, pay fidyah (expiation) of each fast which is 1.633 kg wheat or its price. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
